findings.problem: The hint 'later today' doesn't rule out 'Bis nachher!', which is just as common in Germany for seeing someone again later the same day, and 'Bis gleich!' is also close.
findings.fix: hint: later today, with the everyday word for later (not nachher or gleich)

back.example: I'll call you. See you later!

note: Bis später works with both du and Sie, so this card needs no informal tag, unlike the unit's other phrase cards.
